top_signals.title: Trump Dismisses ‘Little War’ With Iran as Clashes Resume
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump dismissed concerns that the conflict in Iran was draining American firepower, saying "This is a relatively little war for us". Bloomberg's Onur Ant breaks down the latest developments. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
